displayName.zh-Hans: 三角洲行动 · 守夜人的口风琴

$comment: P0 is cosmetic in a relative model: the engine transposes, so the instrument's true concert
pitch never has to be known. 60 (C4) is a readable default.
Structural facts this profile derives (asserted by a pinned fixture test):
6 modifier states, 38 offsets [-12,+25] with zero interior gaps, 48 renderings,
Because the degrees are pairwise distinct, a modifier state uniquely determines the key.

modifiers.$dutyComment: 3x the others ON PURPOSE: left mouse is FIRE in this game, so the objective must actively avoid parking a melody in the low band.

$repitchComment: Conservative assumption: a modifier armed during a previous note's sustain re-pitches that sounding note. If false, the planner may arm modifiers earlier. Unverified - see docs/CALIBRATION.md.
